summary: Grant/update access for AWS & GCP Marketplace vendor portals for listing submitters (Marketplace refresh)
description:
Request type: Vendor portal access change (AWS Marketplace + GCP Cloud Marketplace)

Business context:
We are in active submission cycles for the Cloud Marketplace listing refresh (new SKUs + updated security packet + refreshed copy/screenshots). Current vendor portal access is limited to one legacy submitter account, which is causing bottlenecks and missed review turnaround windows.

Request:
Provision and/or adjust access for designated listing submitters to:
1) AWS Marketplace Management Portal (seller/vendor console)
2) GCP Cloud Marketplace Producer Portal

Requested users + requested roles:
- Soojin Lee (PMM) — Listing editor/publisher access (submit listing copy updates, upload attachments, respond to reviewer comments)
- Camila Reyes (Marketing exec sponsor) — Read-only + approval visibility (review listing text/attachments prior to submission)
- Elliot Price (Docs lead) — Listing attachments uploader (security FAQ links, docs URLs, PDF attachment updates)
- Connor O'Brien (Release Eng) — Backup submitter/editor for launch window + coordination (to avoid single point of failure)

Constraints / policy requirements:
- Follow internal process: sources/confluence/policies-and-process/vendor-management/aws-gcp-marketplace-vendor-account-access-and-rotation
- Individual named accounts only (no shared credentials)
- Enforce MFA for AWS and Google accounts used for seller portals
- Least-privilege roles (admin only where necessary)
- Maintain audit trail (who was granted access, approver, and removal date if temporary)

Desired timeline:
Access granted by EOD 2025-01-20 (to meet AWS review resubmission deadline).

Approvals required:
- Security sign-off: Dr. Aisha Rahman or Marcus Lin
- Business owner: Marketplace refresh stakeholders (PMM/Marketing sponsor)

Notes:
If AWS requires the account owner to invite users, please confirm who is the current root/vendor portal owner and whether we should transfer ownership to a distribution-managed admin account.
